question_bank.stem: The lecture contrasts CNN and LLM interpretability by saying CNNs focus on localized visual features, while LLMs focus on what structure?

options.text: Pixel masks over fixed image patches

question_bank.rationale: The transition says CNNs visualize edges, textures, and shapes, whereas modern language models require visualizing relations between concepts or tokens.

distractor_rationales.B: Pixel masks are CNN-style localization, not the LLM contrast.
distractor_rationales.C: Pooling switches belong to DeconvNet interpretation.
distractor_rationales.D: Transposed-convolution strides are a CNN upsampling topic.

question_bank.stem: Embedding-space diagnostics assume semantically similar tokens should have what geometric relationship?

options.text: They should be close together in the embedding visualization
They should occupy identical positions in every attention head

distractor_rationales.B: Embeddings and attention heads are related but not identical structures.
distractor_rationales.C: Convolutional edge detectors are a CNN feature, not token embeddings.
distractor_rationales.D: Tokenizer statistics may be monitored, but tokens are not removed for being semantically similar.
